messages.author: 6bd230a6f7d12c1b
messages.subject: Introduction for GSOC
parts:
Hello everyone,


I am Siddharth Bhatia, a first year undergraduate student of BITS Pilani, India (http://www.bits-pilani.ac.in/) 


I like R foundation as I have immense interest in both coding and mathematics and thought this is one place where I want to code in my summer and probably beyond. I participated in the national camp of the International Olympiad in Informatics and have done probability and statistics, linear algebra, complex analysis courses in college till now in addition to some maths olympiad stuff.


I am proficient in C++, Matlab, MySql and starting learning python. I started exploring R right now but have been using Matlab and Mathematica for quite some time and qualified for the Wolfram 'New Kind of Science' camp. I liked the Hyperspec project as it includes some of my areas of interest such as plotting functions, optimisation (increasing speed). Also I have studied about spectroscopy in my chemistry course so that is a plus point.


Could Claudia or Katarina maam provide me the manuscript draft for the package so that I could go through it.


Thanks a lot.

Regards.

Siddharth Bhatia.

hyperSpec.r-forge.r-project.org.
